OTA.purpose: Online travel agencies. External reservation identifiers are unique only within their OTA.

fields.OTAName: Commercial name of the booking platform.

BookingStatus.purpose: Lookup of booking lifecycle states; distinct from actual check-in status.

fields.StatusName: Booking lifecycle state supplied or confirmed for a reservation.
fields.IsActive: Whether the status is available for use.

Country.purpose: Countries or nationalities associated with identified guests. The migration seeds 250 flag-backed country/territory entries; subdivision flags are assets, not separate countries.

fields.ISO2Code: Optional unique two-letter country code. XK is a user-assigned Kosovo code, not an official ISO assignment.
fields.FlagUrl: Optional bundled WPF flag resource URL, available without network access.

Room.purpose: The five physical guesthouse rooms. CSV aliases never create new physical rooms. Capacity is informational, not an availability check.

fields.RoomID: Internal physical-room identifier, generated by SQL Server.
fields.RoomName: Canonical internal room name, preserved in Japanese.
fields.IsActive: Whether the physical room is active.
fields.Capacity: Maximum physical guest capacity; not the number of individually managed beds.
fields.DefaultTaxPolicyID: Optional internal tax calculation preference. Does not determine the legally applicable policy or rewrite historical calculations.

Bed.purpose: Individually identifiable dormitory beds. Private rooms have no individual bed records and can still be assigned as whole rooms.

fields.BedLabel: Japanese bed position, unique within its room; the same label may occur in another room.

PaymentMethod.purpose: Methods referenced by actual ReservationPayment movements and by Reservation.SourcePaymentMethodID. A source-designated method alone does not prove receipt of money.

fields.MethodName: Payment method name, including the source designation Internet payment.
fields.IsActive: Whether the method is available for use.

DocumentType.purpose: Categories of optional guest identity documents. Access and retention must follow the guesthouse privacy policy.

fields.IsActive: Whether this category is available for use.

ExtraService.purpose: Catalog of additional services. Suggested prices must not alter historical reservation charges.

fields.DefaultUnitPrice: Suggested non-negative unit price; not a historical sale amount.
fields.IsActive: Whether the service is available for use.

ReservationGroup.purpose: Related bookings, independent of continuous stays. Booking.com and Hostelworld may group by OTA-scoped booking prefix; staff group assignments are preserved.

fields.ExternalGroupReference: Optional reference; automatic groups use OTA ID and booking prefix.
fields.LogoUrl: Optional bundled combined-OTA logo for grouped bookings; never replaces each reservation's actual OTA.

Customer.purpose: Guest identities. Under the staff-approved rule of 2026-11-07, equal normalized full names automatically reuse the same customer across files and OTAs. Existing records and staff data are not merged or overwritten.

fields.FullName: Original guest name. Imports match by Unicode Form KC, collapsed whitespace and invariant uppercase; different names remain separate. If older duplicate records exist, new bookings reuse the lowest CustomerID without changing old links.
fields.PhoneNumber: Optional contact telephone, stored as text.
fields.Email: Optional contact email; not automatically a verified identity.
fields.IsRegularCustomer: Staff designation of a returning guest.
fields.CreatedAt: Local Japanese wall-clock time when this record was created.

Reservation.purpose: Original OTA booking and operational record. Never merge its identity, dates, payments or import history with another booking.

fields.OTAID: Booking platform that owns the external reservation identifier.
fields.ExternalReservationNumber: Optional external booking number; unique for this OTA when present.
fields.GroupID: Related booking group; automatic OTA-scoped grouping does not overwrite staff choices.
fields.BookingStatusID: Booking lifecycle state, separate from check-in status.
fields.SourcePaymentMethodID: Source-designated payment method. Staff rule: a supported price in booking details designates Internet payment. This is not evidence of guesthouse cash receipt and never creates ReservationPayment automatically.
fields.BookedAt: Original source booking timestamp; inserts and review are ordered by this value, independently of OTA. Database query results require ORDER BY BookedAt.
fields.ModifiedAtSource: Optional latest modification timestamp reported by the source.
fields.CheckOutDate: Scheduled departure date, exclusive for occupied nights.
fields.ExpectedGuestCount: Expected number of guests, distinct from the number of identified customer records.
fields.ActualCheckInAt: Actual check-in timestamp entered by staff; imports must preserve it.
fields.CheckInStatus: Pending, CheckedIn or NoShow. ActualCheckInAt must be populated only for CheckedIn.
fields.IsActive: Whether the reservation record is active; separate from cancelled booking status.
fields.IsModified: Indicates that this reservation has been modified.
fields.ConsecutiveStayInfo: Raw source rate schedule, not customer identity evidence.
fields.RoomRateInfo: Raw descriptive rate information; never add it again to nightly charges.
fields.BookingDetails: Raw general booking details, including unrecognized text.
fields.UpdatedAt: Local Japanese wall-clock modification time, maintained by the application.

ReservationCustomer.purpose: Many-to-many association between identified guests and bookings. ExpectedGuestCount may exceed the number of known guests.

fields.ReservationID: Original reservation associated with the guest.
fields.CustomerID: Identified guest associated with the booking.
fields.IsLeadGuest: Marks the lead guest; at most one lead guest is allowed per reservation.
fields.AddedAt: Local timestamp when the association was created.

ReservationAccommodation.purpose: Time-bounded assignment of a reservation to a whole room or a reliably identified bed. No automatic occupancy enforcement.

fields.RoomID: Assigned physical room, required even for a bed assignment.
fields.BedID: Optional explicitly identified bed. NULL supports whole private rooms. The composite foreign key ensures the bed belongs to RoomID.
fields.Notes: Optional staff notes for the assignment.

ReservationCharge.purpose: Billable nightly and extra-service line items. A nightly source price is the total room price: quantity 1, never guest count. Included breakfast is not split without evidence.

fields.ExtraServiceID: Optional catalog service that originated this line.
fields.ChargeType: Accommodation, Breakfast, Laundry, Towel, LateCheckIn, Tax, Discount, Adjustment or Other.
fields.ServiceDate: Optional night or service date for this item.
fields.Quantity: Billable quantity. A total nightly room price normally uses 1.
fields.UnitPrice: Exact unit price. Negative values are allowed only for Discount or Adjustment.
fields.Amount: Persisted computed amount: Quantity multiplied by UnitPrice, stored as decimal(18,2).
fields.CurrencyCode: Three-letter currency code; financial summaries remain separate per currency.
fields.SourceLineKey: Stable imported-line key, unique within a reservation when present, for safe re-import.
fields.CreatedAt: Local timestamp when this billable line was created.

ReservationPayment.purpose: Actual money movements, not inferred from OTA deposit text. Receipts and refunds are distinct from charges and tax snapshots.

fields.Direction: Inflow or Outflow from the guesthouse perspective.
fields.CounterpartyType: Guest, OTA, Guesthouse or Other; identifies payer/payee.
fields.Amount: Positive exact amount of the actual financial movement, not a computed charge.
fields.PaidAt: Optional timestamp when money actually moved.
fields.Notes: Optional staff notes; preserve on CSV re-import.

OTAStatementItem.purpose: Amounts stated by the OTA, including ambiguous deposit figures. Informational until classified; excluded from the financial view.

fields.ReservationID: Original reservation referenced by the statement.
fields.RawLabel: Literal source label, such as deposit.
fields.RawText: Original text for this statement item.
fields.Amount: Non-negative exact amount declared by the OTA; not evidence of payment or commission.
fields.Classification: Unclassified until evidence supports Commission, GuestDeposit, Payout, TaxWithheld or Other.
fields.ResolutionNotes: Staff explanation or evidence used to classify the item.
fields.ImportedAt: Local timestamp when this item was imported.
fields.SourceLineKey: Stable source-line key, unique within the reservation when present.

PaymentAllocation.purpose: Optional allocation of an actual receipt/refund to billable items. Unallocated advance payments are permitted. Same reservation/currency and amount limits require service validation.

fields.AllocatedAmount: Positive portion allocated; application validation must prevent over-allocation.

StayMemo.purpose: Staff notes attached to a continuous visit rather than a single OTA reservation. Imports preserve notes when adjacent stays for the same customer are linked.

fields.StayID: Operational visit to which the note belongs.
fields.CreatedAt: Local timestamp when the note was created.

CustomerDocument.purpose: Optional guest documentation metadata. Files are stored separately and require restricted access and retention controls.

fields.CustomerID: Identified guest who owns this document.
fields.FileStorageKey: Optional local storage key for the document file.
fields.PhotoStorageKey: Optional local storage key for its photo.
fields.CreatedAt: Local timestamp when the metadata was created.

ImportBatch.purpose: Transactional import audit per source OTA. Combined files produce one batch per OTA with complete original file bytes. Re-imports create new audit history, not duplicate bookings.

fields.OTAID: OTA whose rows were processed; the source file may also contain other OTAs.
fields.ImportedAt: Local timestamp when the batch was recorded.
fields.SourceFileHash: SHA-256 hexadecimal fingerprint of the original file bytes; nullable for legacy batches.
fields.SourceEncoding: Strictly decoded source encoding used by the parser.
fields.SourceFileContent: Complete original CSV bytes, including BOM, original encoding and line endings. Contains personal data: restrict access and apply the guesthouse retention policy.
fields.ParserVersion: Verified source parser version used for this batch.

ImportRow.purpose: Original source row and parsing outcome, retained for audit and future parser improvements. Preview does not persist rows.

fields.SourceRowNumber: Source record number, unique within its import batch.
fields.ReservationID: Optional reservation produced or matched by the parser.
fields.RawDetails: Original 詳細 field, if present.
fields.RawPayload: JSON containing original headers, all values including unknown columns, and the original decoded CSV record. Full file bytes are retained separately in ImportBatch.
fields.ParseStatus: Processed for newly created reservations and approved source updates/cancellations; Skipped for held/duplicate rows; Failed for invalid CSV structure. Only the latest Processed source fingerprint defines unchanged data. No held/invalid reservation is silently saved.
fields.ParseError: Source-row outcome, validation warning or reason for review.
fields.SourceRowHash: SHA-256 of ordered original header/value pairs. Used only within the same OTA booking identity to recognize unchanged imports; not a guest identity.

TaxPolicy.purpose: Versioned accommodation-tax policy catalog. A room's selected operational policy is distinct from the legally applicable rule for each night.

fields.PolicyName: Unique staff-facing policy name, including the version/year.
fields.ValidFrom: First legally applicable service date, inclusive.
fields.ValidTo: Optional end of legal validity, exclusive.
fields.IsActive: Whether staff may select this policy; historical references remain intact.
fields.Notes: Official source and verification notes. Both seeded policies have verified, approved brackets; actual calculation still requires a reliable accommodation-only taxable base.

TaxBracket.purpose: Official Kyoto tax brackets per accommodation-only price per person/night, verified and staff-approved on 2026-11-06. Meals and consumption tax are excluded.

fields.MinPriceInclusive: Inclusive lower bound of the taxable accommodation-only price per person/night.
fields.MaxPriceExclusive: Exclusive upper bound; NULL means no upper limit.
fields.TaxPerPersonNight: Exact tax due per guest/night in this bracket.

ReservationTax.purpose: Historical tax calculation snapshot, separate from billable charges and actual collections. Breakfast-inclusive room rates do not establish a reliable taxable base.

fields.ReservationID: Original reservation to which this snapshot belongs.
fields.ServiceDate: Night being assessed; legal policy is selected using this date.
fields.RoomID: Optional physical room relevant to the calculation.
fields.LegalTaxPolicyID: Policy legally applicable for the night, if established.
fields.AppliedTaxPolicyID: Snapshot of the internal policy used; changing a room default must not rewrite this value.
fields.GuestCount: Reliable number of guests used to calculate tax, if known.
fields.TaxablePricePerPerson: Reliable accommodation-only taxable price per person/night; never infer it from a breakfast-inclusive room total.
fields.LegalTaxAmount: Tax due under the legal rule, if reliably calculated.
fields.ChargedTaxAmount: Amount actually charged to guests, if known; not necessarily the legal amount or an actual payment.
fields.CalculationStatus: PendingReview, Calculated, Confirmed or NotApplicable. Missing reliable base must remain PendingReview.
fields.Notes: Evidence, review reason, discrepancy or adjustment explanation.
fields.CalculatedAt: Optional local timestamp when the snapshot was produced.

Stay.purpose: Operationally continuous visit by one customer. Adjacent dates and the same customer, including automatic normalized-name matches, can link stays across OTAs without merging reservations. Nonconsecutive visits remain separate; cancelled booking links exclude automatic adjacency.

fields.CustomerID: Guest whose visit this represents; matching normalized full names reuse this identity under the current staff-approved import rule.
fields.StartDate: First arrival date of the operational visit.
fields.EndDate: Final departure date, exclusive for occupied nights.
fields.Notes: Staff explanation of the link between original bookings.
fields.CreatedAt: Local timestamp when the operational stay was recorded.

StayReservation.purpose: Associates separate original bookings with a customer's continuous stay. One family reservation may participate in different guests' stays.

fields.ReservationID: Original booking; its OTA identifiers, finances and history remain separate.
fields.AddedAt: Local timestamp when the association was created by staff or an approved import.

OTARoomMapping.purpose: Known OTA-specific room names, then unique generic aliases. Approved imports save OTA attribution; conflicts require a staff room choice. Room codes remain only in raw CSV audit.

fields.OTAID: Optional specific booking platform learned from approved CSV rows; NULL means a generic seed alias.
fields.RoomID: Existing physical room recognized by this alias.
fields.ExternalRoomName: Original external room name, preserved without normalization.
fields.NormalizedName: Unicode Form KC, collapsed Unicode whitespace and invariant uppercase used for matching.
fields.IsActive: Whether the alias participates in matching.
fields.CreatedAt: Local timestamp when the alias was created.

examples.ExternalRoomName: 順【ミックスドミトリー4bed】

vwReservationFinancialSummary.purpose: Read-only amounts per reservation and currency, with charges/payments independently aggregated to avoid multiplication. Excludes ambiguous OTA statements and tax snapshots.

fields.ReservationID: Original reservation summarized by this row.
fields.CurrencyCode: Currency of all amounts in this row.
fields.TotalCharged: Sum of billable charge amounts in this currency.
fields.NetCashMovement: Actual inflows minus outflows in this currency.
fields.UnreconciledDifference: Charges minus net cash movement; not automatically a confirmed guest debt.
